```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r library}
library(data.table)
library(here)
library(tictoc)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
```

```{r year to load}
year_to_load <- "2018"
```

```{r parameters}
# file paths
path_to_raw_claims <- "data-cleaning/raw_claims/"
path_to_intermediate <- "data-cleaning/intermediate_claims/"
path_to_cache <- "data-cleaning/cache"
suffix <- ifelse(to_sample, "_sampled", "_full")
chunk_droppable_cols_file <- here(path_to_cache, paste0("chunk_droppable_cols_", year_to_load, suffix, ".rds"))
header_file <- here(path_to_cache, paste0("header_", year_to_load, suffix, ".rds"))
total_rows_file <- here(path_to_cache, paste0("total_rows_", year_to_load, suffix, ".rds"))
sampled_claims <- here(paste0(path_to_raw_claims, "sampled_claims_extract_CLAIMS_", year_to_load, ".csv"))
full_claims <- here(paste0(path_to_raw_claims, "claims_extract_CLAIMS_", year_to_load, ".csv"))
intermediate_file <- here(paste0(path_to_intermediate, "intermediate_claims_", year_to_load, "_processed.csv"))

# parameters
sample_size <- 25000
chunk_size <- 1000000

drop_cols <- 76:196 # Columns to drop (based on indexes)

to_read <- FALSE
to_sample <- TRUE
to_write <- FALSE
to_chunk <- FALSE

# seed
set.seed(123)  # Set seed for reproducibility
```

```{r data formats}
# Define column types
character_cols <- c("PSEUDO_CLAIMSERIES", "PSEUDO_MEM_PIN", "HCI_PMCC_NO",
                    "HCP_NO_LIST", "PRIMARY_ILLNESS", "SECONDARY_ILLNESS",
                    paste0("ICDCODE", c(1:14, 16:170)), "ICCODED15",
                    paste0("RVSCODE", 1:20), "DATE_ADM", "TIME_ADM",
                    "DATE_DIS", "TIME_DIS", "DATE_REC", "DATE_REF", 
                    "CHKDT", "PAT_BDAY", "EXTRACTION_DATE")
integer_cols = c("OUT_PATIENT", "EMERGENCY")
factor_cols = c("PATIENT_TYPE", "ROOM_TYPE", "DEP_REL", "PATSEX", 
                "MEMCAT_PARENT_DESC", "MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC", 
                "MEMCAT_SUBCHILD_DESC", "DISPOSITION", "CLAIMS_STATUS")
numeric_cols = c("PATAGE", "PAT_BWT_KG", "CLAIMS_PAID_AMT", 
                 "ACR_AMOUNT_ACTUAL")
na_values <- c('NONE','None','-','--','---','N/A','n/a','nan','NAN') 
na_like_strings <- c("", " ", "  ", "-", "none", "None", "NONE", "NA", "n/a", 
                     "N/A", "NaN", "'", "\t", "\n", "\r", "\f", "\v", "\u00A0", 
                     "\u2000", "\u2001", "\u2002", "\u2003", "\u2004", "\u2005",
                     "\u2006", "\u2007", "\u2008", "\u2009", "\u200A", "\u2028",
                     "\u2029", "\u202F", "\u205F", "\u3000")
```

```{r functions}
read_entire_file <- function() {
  tic("Reading entire data file")
  df <- fread(full_claims,
              na.strings = na_values)
  toc()
  return(df)
}

read_sampled_file <- function() {
  df <- fread(sampled_claims,
              na.strings = na_values)
  return(df)
}

sample_data <- function(df) {
  df <- df[sample(.N, min(sample_size, .N))]
  return(df)
}

write_data <- function(df, path) {
  fwrite(df, path)
}

process_and_collapse_columns <- function(df, cols_to_process, new_col_name) {
  for (col in cols_to_process) {
    set(df, j = col, value = iconv(df[[col]], to = "UTF-8", sub = "byte"))
    set(df, j = col, value = toupper(df[[col]]))
    set(df, j = col, value = str_trim(df[[col]]))
    set(df, j = col, value = str_replace_all(df[[col]], " ", ""))
    set(df, j = col, value = str_replace_all(df[[col]], "\n", ""))
    set(df, j = col, value = str_replace_all(df[[col]], "[^\\w\\d\\/\\s]+", ""))
    set(df, j = col, value = ifelse(df[[col]] %in% na_like_strings, NA_character_, df[[col]]))
  }

  df[, (new_col_name) := do.call(paste, c(.SD, sep = "||")), .SDcols = cols_to_process]
  df[, (new_col_name) := str_replace_all(get(new_col_name), "\\|\\|NA", "")]
  df[, (new_col_name) := str_replace_all(get(new_col_name), "NA\\|\\|", "")]
  df[, (new_col_name) := str_replace_all(get(new_col_name), "\\|\\|$", "")]
  df[, (new_col_name) := ifelse(get(new_col_name) == "NA", NA_character_, get(new_col_name))]

  df[, (cols_to_process) := NULL]
}

process_patient_type <- function(df) {
  df[, PATIENT_TYPE := fcase(
    PATIENT_TYPE == "MEMBER", "MEM",
    PATIENT_TYPE == "DEPENDENT", "DEP"
  )]
  return(df)
}

process_memcat_parent_desc <- function(df) {
  df[, MEMCAT_PARENT_DESC := fcase(
    MEMCAT_PARENT_DESC == "DIRECT CONTRIBUTOR", "DIRECT",
    MEMCAT_PARENT_DESC == "INDIRECT CONTRIBUTOR", "INDIRECT"
  )]
  return(df)
}

process_memcat_child_desc <- function(df) {
  df[, MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC := fcase(
    MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "EMPLOYED PRIVATE", "FORMAL",
    MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "SELF-EARNING INDIVIDUAL", "INFORMAL",
    MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "SENIOR CITIZEN", "SENIOR",
    MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "INDIGENT", "INDIGENT",
    MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "LIFETIME MEMBER", "LIFETIME",
    MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "SPONSORED", "SPONSORED",
    MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "MIGRANT WORKER", "INFORMAL",
    MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "EMPLOYED GOVERNMENT", "FORMAL",
    MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "INFORMAL ECONOMY", "INFORMAL",
    MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "HOUSEHOLD HELP/KASAMBAHAY", "FORMAL",
    MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "FOREIGN NATIONAL", "INFORMAL",
    MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "FILIPINOS WITH DUAL CITIZENSHIP / LIVING ABROAD", "INFORMAL",
    MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "SELF EARNING INDIVIDUAL", "INFORMAL",
    MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "FAMILY DRIVER", "FORMAL"
  )]
  return(df)
}

process_disposition <- function(df) {
  df[, DISPOSITION := fcase(
    DISPOSITION == "IMPROVED", 1L,
    DISPOSITION == "RECOVERED", 1L,
    DISPOSITION == "HOME/DISCHARGED AGAINST MEDICAL ADVICE", 2L,
    DISPOSITION == "ABSCONDED", 3L,
    DISPOSITION == "TRANSFERRED/REFERRED", 4L,
    DISPOSITION == "EXPIRED", 9L,
    DISPOSITION == "UNDEFINED", NA_integer_
  )]
  return(df)
}

process_icd_codes <- function(df) {
  icd_cols <- intersect(colnames(df), c(paste0("ICDCODE", c(1:14, 16:170)), "ICCODED15"))
  process_and_collapse_columns(df, icd_cols, "ICD_CODES")
  return(df)
}

process_rvs_codes <- function(df) {
  rvs_cols <- intersect(colnames(df), paste0("RVSCODE", 1:20))
  process_and_collapse_columns(df, rvs_cols, "RVS_CODES")
  return(df)
}

process_data <- function(df, year_to_load) {
  tic("Processing data")
  
  # Keep necessary columns
  cols_to_keep <- setdiff(1:ncol(df), drop_cols)
  df <- df[, ..cols_to_keep]
  
  # Add a column id_year and set its value to the variable year_to_load
  df[, SRC_YR := as.integer(year_to_load)]
  
  # Call individual processing functions
  df <- process_patient_type(df)
  df <- process_memcat_parent_desc(df)
  df <- process_memcat_child_desc(df)
  df <- process_disposition(df)
  df <- process_icd_codes(df)
  df <- process_rvs_codes(df)
  
  toc()
  return(df)
}

process_chunk <- function(chunk_number, skip_rows, cols_to_keep, total_rows) {
  tic(paste("Processing chunk", chunk_number))
  
  df <- fread(full_claims,
              skip = skip_rows,
              nrows = chunk_size,
              select = cols_to_keep,
              na.strings = na_values)
  
  setnames(df, colnames(header)[cols_to_keep])
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    toc()
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Identify droppable columns in this chunk
  droppable_cols <- sapply(df, function(col) all(is.na(col) | col %in% na_like_strings))
  droppable_cols <- which(droppable_cols)
  
  df <- process_data(df, year_to_load)
  
  intermediate_path <- here(paste0(path_to_intermediate, "intermediate_chunk_", chunk_number, ".csv"))
  fwrite(df, intermediate_path)
  
  toc()
  return(droppable_cols)
}
```

```{r reading}
if (to_read) {
  df <- read_entire_file()
  
  if (to_sample) {
    if (file.exists(sampled_claims)) {
      df <- read_sampled_file()
    } else {
      df <- sample_data(df)
      if (to_write) {
        write_data(df, sampled_claims)
      }
    }
  }
} else {
  if (to_sample) {
    if (file.exists(sampled_claims)) {
      df <- read_sampled_file()
    } else {
      df <- read_entire_file()
      df <- sample_data(df)
      if (to_write) {
        write_data(df, sampled_claims)
      }
    }
  } else if (to_chunk) {
    if (!file.exists(chunk_droppable_cols_file) || !file.exists(header_file) || !file.exists(total_rows_file)) {
      process_chunks()
    } else {
      chunk_droppable_cols <- readRDS(chunk_droppable_cols_file)
      header <- readRDS(header_file)
      total_rows <- readRDS(total_rows_file)
    }
  } else {
    stop("Cannot proceed: to_read is FALSE, to_sample is FALSE, and to_chunk is FALSE. At least one must be TRUE.")
  }
}
```

```{r identify droppable columns}
if (to_read || (to_sample && !file.exists(sampled_claims))) {
  chunk_number <- 1
  chunk_droppable_cols <- list()
  header <- names(df)
  total_rows <- nrow(df)

  tic("Processing header row")
  # Get the columns to keep by excluding the drop columns
  cols_to_keep <- setdiff(seq_along(header), drop_cols)
  toc()

  tic("Identifying droppable columns")
  # Check which columns can be dropped
  droppable_cols <- sapply(df, function(col) all(is.na(col) | col %in% na_like_strings))
  droppable_cols <- which(droppable_cols)
  chunk_droppable_cols[[paste0(year_to_load, "_whole")]] <- droppable_cols
  toc()

  saveRDS(chunk_droppable_cols, chunk_droppable_cols_file)
  saveRDS(header, header_file)
  saveRDS(total_rows, total_rows_file)
}
```

```{r process data in chunks}
if (to_sample == FALSE && to_chunk == TRUE && to_write == TRUE) {
  tic("Processing data in chunks")
  
  header <- fread(full_claims, nrows = 1, header = TRUE)
  total_rows <- fread(full_claims, select = 1L, header = TRUE)[, .N]
  cols_to_keep <- setdiff(seq_along(header), drop_cols)
  
  chunk_number <- 1
  repeat {
    skip_rows <- (chunk_number - 1) * chunk_size + 1
    if (skip_rows > total_rows) break
    
    droppable_cols <- process_chunk(chunk_number, skip_rows, cols_to_keep, total_rows)
    if (is.null(droppable_cols)) break
    
    chunk_number <- chunk_number + 1
  }
  
  toc()
}
```

```{r merge intermediate files}
if (to_sample == FALSE && to_chunk == TRUE && to_write == TRUE) {
  tic("Merging intermediate files")
  
  intermediate_files <- list.files(path_to_intermediate, pattern = "intermediate_chunk_.*\\.csv", full.names = TRUE)
  df_list <- lapply(intermediate_files, fread)
  df <- rbindlist(df_list)
  
  fwrite(df, intermediate_file)
  
  toc()
}
```

```{r process data if not chunking}
if (to_chunk == FALSE && exists("df")) {
  df <- process_data(df, year_to_load)
  
  if (to_write) {
    fwrite(df, intermediate_file)
  }
}
```
